Name: unsupervised_functional_clustering
Title: Do Evo2 Embeddings Spontaneously Cluster by Gene Function? Unsupervised Geometry Analysis
Experiment: Load the cached embeddings from run_0/data/embeddings_evo2_7b.npy and labels from run_0/data/dataset.json. Perform unsupervised analysis: (1) K-means clustering (k=2) on embeddings, compute Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) and Normalized Mutual Information (NMI) against true functional labels. Compare ARI to a permutation null (shuffle labels 1000 times). (2) Compute mean within-class cosine distance vs mean between-class cosine distance — ratio < 1.0 indicates functional clustering. (3) Generate a UMAP projection (2D) colored by functional class and save as PNG. (4) Compute silhouette score for the true functional labels in embedding space. Report all metrics with statistical significance vs null. This tests whether Evo2 embeddings organize genes by function WITHOUT any supervised signal.

Name: hierarchical_functional_structure
Title: Hierarchical Functional Organization and Cross-Class Bridges in Evo2 Embedding Space
Experiment: Load cached embeddings (run_0/data/embeddings_evo2_7b.npy) and dataset (run_0/data/dataset.json). (1) Annotate sub-pathways: for each DNA repair gene symbol in the cached dataset, determine which original KEGG pathway(s) it came from by re-querying the pathway lists (hsa03430=MMR, hsa03420=NER, hsa03440=HR, hsa03410=BER); tag each gene with sub-pathway label. (2) Identify bridge genes: find gene symbols that appear in both DNA repair and TSG lists (e.g., BRCA1, BRCA2, MLH1, MSH2, MSH6, PMS2). (3) Hierarchical clustering: perform Ward linkage clustering on embeddings, compute cophenetic correlation, generate dendrogram colored by class and sub-pathway. (4) Sub-pathway coherence: for each DNA repair sub-pathway with ≥3 genes, compute mean pairwise cosine distance within sub-pathway vs between different sub-pathways (within DNA repair class). Compare to null distribution from 1000 permutations of sub-pathway labels. (5) Bridge gene analysis: compute mean cosine distance from each bridge gene to DNA repair centroid vs TSG centroid; test if bridge genes are significantly closer to DNA repair centroid than other TSGs (t-test). (6) Visualize: UMAP colored by sub-pathway, dendrogram, and distance distribution plots. Report all metrics with p-values.
